annotations.title: Find fence contractors near a homeowner

description: For homeowners looking for a fence. Lists verified fence contractors (businesses that have confirmed their contact details with GroundQuote) near a US ZIP or city, in two groups, each contractor only within their own service radius: instant_quote (GroundQuote contractors with published rates — use contractor_id with get_fence_estimate) and listed_only (verified directory contractors without published rates — share their directory link or phone; do not invent prices). unverified_nearby counts other directory contractors who have not verified yet and are not listed; browse_directory_url is the public directory page for the area, to share when the homeowner wants more choice or nothing verified is nearby. Free for homeowners.

state.description: Two-letter US state, e.g. "NC". Required unless zip is given.

zip.description: Homeowner's 5-digit ZIP; most precise for distance
